name: 36111 · Montgomery, AL
findings: ZIP 36111 (Montgomery) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36111 (Montgomery) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 36111 (Montgomery) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
